audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers ran Skill/Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Skill/Lucian, contradicting the packet chart (Karma, Skill, Karma, Skill, Lucian, Skill, Skill), the 44.9% win rate, and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Inner Flame (Q) is 950 range against Lucian's 500 Q and 900 W; Karma owns the step-up levels. Mirror karma__lucian already set the packet chart in both layers.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped to Karma, Skill, Karma, Skill, Lucian, Skill, Skill in both layers with matched win[N] pairs and re-scaled ratings. The content whys already described exactly this shape, so only the sides were wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was rated Skill and written as lane-clear utility; it is Lucian's single clean kill window.
audit.why: Inspire (E) is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and Mantra is 40/38/36/34s. When both are spent Karma has zero escape and Lucian's W move speed plus The Culling runs her down.
audit.corrected: Level 6 set to Lucian 7/10 with the Inspire cooldown stated; 4-5 and 2+ items set to Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interactions row only said 'break it with range or line of sight' and never named the anti-heal requirement flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.why: Focused Resolve (W) is a 675-range tether that roots only if unbroken, and Mantra-W heals Karma while extending the root — extended trades need Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now states the line-of-sight break and the Executioner's timing against Mantra-W healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Don't #1 was filler ('decline politely and watch it retire').
audit.why: The concrete reason is the 950 vs 500 range gap.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Inner Flame (Q) reaches 950 to your 500 — she chips your base HP on every last-hit before Lightslinger can answer.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: E online — dash-weave trades start now, but Inner Flame still out-ranges you, so even is the ceiling.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Mantra-Q plus Focused Resolve (W) arrive — the root pins you for free poke, so never step in while Mantra is up.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Focused Resolve (Tether) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Her Inspire (E) shield and its move speed kite your W mark as easily as you dash her Q — a genuine skill check at 4-5.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: The Culling is your window — bait Inspire (E), then W-speed onto her before her 8s shield refreshes.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: She out-pokes and out-scales, but a fed Lucian still one-combos an enchanter — leads decide this, not the kits.

edits.before: Track Karma’s Focused Resolve (Tether): The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Focused Resolve (W) is 675 range and breaks on line of sight — dash behind terrain and it never roots. Mantra-W heals her: buy Executioner's first.

edits.before: That is Karma’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Inner Flame reaches 950 to your 500 — closing costs more HP than the trade returns.

notes: The full layer refers to Karma as 'he/his' throughout (tradeGood, breakdown.wave, phases). The content layer correctly uses 'she'. Pronoun fixes were not proposed here because they touch a dozen prose fields whose length bands are tight; flagging for a champion-level pass. Also: 'Focused Resolve (Tether)' is used as the ability label everywhere in the full layer — 'Tether' is a descriptor, not part of Riot's name (Focused Resolve). Left as-is since it is not a fabrication, but the style guide may want it trimmed.
